top_violation_types.title: CPR Training and Recertification Adhere to Guidelines-skill based (26 TAC §746.1315(b)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The on-line CPR recertification training obtain did not include use of a CPR manikin.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care (26 TAC §747.5003(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan (26 TAC §747.5003(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan did not contain a reuinification plan.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Posted in Each Room (26 TAC §746.5207(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An evacuation diagram was not posted in the multipurpose classroom where PreK and School Age Children were present doing activities.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when the director posted the evacuation diagram.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.
